/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib
import re
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
errors = []
links = 0
for source in root.rglob('*.md'):
    if '.git' in source.parts:
        continue
    for target in re.findall(r'\\[["'^'"\\]]*\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', source.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        destination = source.parent / name if name else source
        links += 1
        if not destination.is_file():
            errors.append(f'{source.relative_to(root)}: missing {target}')
        elif anchor and destination.suffix == '.md':
            headings = re.findall(r'"'^#+'"\\s+(.+)"'$'"', destination.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'["'^'"\\w\\- ]', '', heading.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for heading in headings]
            if anchor not in slugs:
                errors.append(f'{source.relative_to(root)}: missing anchor {target}')
print(f'Checked {links} local Markdown links.')
for error in errors:
    print(error)
raise SystemExit(bool(errors))
PY"
